Priya: quick PR to tidy the hello quickstart: swap demo API key for ephemeral token, add a tiny preflight checklist, and call out PROJECT_REGION. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4601
Owen: nice. please add PROJECT_REGION to the checklist or deploy will fail silently.
Lina: also update env var name in screenshots from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_TOKEN and pin example to @redwood/sdk@^8.1.0
Priya: will update screenshot and pin SDK. snippet planned:
```js
// pinned to @redwood/sdk@^8.1.0
const token = await client.auth.getEphemeralToken({ ttl: 60 }) // ttl in seconds
await fetch('/api/start', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
```
